Rebuild the fixed revision the same way so the comparison is like for like.
Run the eight selected cases on the buggy revision, using the file path plus -k (no file::node id, no bare -k).
actions.command: python -m pytest pandas/tests/test_nanops.py -k "test_nanargminmax_uint64_with_mask or test_idxminmax_uint64_with_na or test_nanargminmax_uint64_na_tie or test_nanargminmax_int64_na_tie or test_nanargminmax_float_inf_tie or test_idxminmax_uint64_all_zero_with_na or test_idxminmax_float_inf_tie or test_returned_dtype" -q

actions.step: Run the same selector on the fixed revision.
actions.command: python -m pytest pandas/tests/test_nanops.py -k "test_nanargminmax_uint64_with_mask or test_idxminmax_uint64_with_na or test_nanargminmax_uint64_na_tie or test_nanargminmax_int64_na_tie or test_nanargminmax_float_inf_tie or test_idxminmax_uint64_all_zero_with_na or test_idxminmax_float_inf_tie or test_returned_dtype" -q

plans.success_criterion: Both revisions import the built package; on buggy the selected cases fail with real assertion failures (not collection/import errors), and on fixed they pass.
